title: Agency Analyzer V2.1 Runner: import v1.2 and write report
abstract: Uses official agency_analyzer_v2 to import schema-aligned v1.2 actions and write a no-visualization report to shared/agency_lab/analyses.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json

def main():
    base = "storage/shared/agency_lab"
    acts = os.path.join(base, "axiom_rng_actions_v1_2.json")
    out_dir = os.path.join(base, "analyses")
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "axiom_report_v1_2.txt")

    sys.path.append(os.path.join(base, "frameworks"))
    from agency_analyzer_v2 import AgencyAnalyzerV2  # official v2.1

    if not os.path.exists(acts):
        print("MISSING_INPUT", acts)
        return 0

    with open(acts, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        batch = json.load(f)

    analyzer = AgencyAnalyzerV2()
    analyzer.import_action_batch(batch, source="axiom_rng_v1_2")
    report = analyzer.generate_enhanced_report()

    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(report)

    try:
        analyzer.save_state()
    except Exception:
        pass

    print("WROTE", out_path)
    print("PREVIEW")
    for i, line in enumerate(report.splitlines()):
        if i >= 10: break
        print(line)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
